vBRIEFInfo.description: Plan for PAN-2338: Boot Reconciliation lists every historical stopped agent as a resume candidate; 'Resume all' is a silent no-op

plan.title: Boot Reconciliation lists every historical stopped agent as a resume candidate; 'Resume all' is a silent no-op
plan.author: agent:claude-opus-4-8

narratives.Problem: isBootReconciliationCandidate (src/lib/cloister/boot-reconciliation.ts:47-52) gates only on role/status/paused/troubled/stoppedByUser, so every all-time 'stopped' work agent (weeks old, workspace gone, issue merged/closed) is offered as a boot resume candidate. 'Resume all' then attempts each, the resume path declines terminal agents, and the route returns count:0 while the modal prints a bare 'No agents were resumed.' The agents table also grows unbounded (44 dead PAN-1791 swarm-slot rows) because terminal rows are never reaped.
narratives.Proposal: FR-1: gate candidates to genuinely-interrupted, resumable work — recent lastActivity relative to a stamped bootStartedAt within a new reconciliation_max_candidate_age_secs window, a workspace that still exists on disk, and a non-terminal issue stage (verifying_on_main/closed/cancelled). Also tighten the GET display so old non-candidate stopped rows disappear. FR-2: applyBootReconciliationDecision returns per-agent {outcome, reason} results surfaced through both routes and rendered as a real summary in the modal. FR-3: add pan admin db gc-agents to reap terminal/orphaned work-agent rows + state dirs through the write door (removeAgentSync).
narratives.NonGoals:
- Do NOT change the grace-window timer or the resume_all-on-grace-expiry default.
- Do NOT reap paused/troubled rows (intentionally held).
- Do NOT add recency/terminal gates to autoResumeStoppedWorkAgents (steady-state patrol); scope is boot reconciliation only.
- Do NOT modify resume.ts session-resolution logic.
- Do NOT bootstrap .pan/context/codebase/*.md in this issue.

autoDecisions.summary: Predicate reads bootStartedAt from boot state and max-age from config internally rather than changing isBootReconciliationCandidate's signature.
autoDecisions.rationale: The predicate is called from three sites; the two non-boot sites run after boot stamping so reading state keeps one predicate and avoids threading context through unrelated call sites.

autoDecisions.summary: Recency source = lastActivity (fallback stoppedAt, then startedAt); agents with no timestamp are excluded.
autoDecisions.rationale: Fail-closed: an agent that can't be proven recently-active must not be offered for resume — that is the exact bug being fixed.
The PRD suggests ~2x grace; 240s comfortably covers a genuine crash-interruption window without admitting weeks-old rows.

autoDecisions.summary: Terminal-issue detection uses the local overdeck issues.stage cache via a new sync helper, treating verifying_on_main/closed/cancelled as terminal.
autoDecisions.rationale: The candidate predicate is synchronous and must stay inside the read door; the issues table stage column is the sync-accessible source already written by the pipeline.

autoDecisions.summary: GET /api/boot-reconciliation keeps showing paused/troubled/remote rows (read-only) but drops the blanket stopped clause.
autoDecisions.rationale: FR-1's 'empty list on a fresh boot with only old agents' targets resume candidates; paused/troubled are a separate, already read-only operator concern and removing them would be scope creep.
This is a bounded bug fix touching known files; a full codebase-context bootstrap is out of proportion to the change.

items.title: Add reconciliation_max_candidate_age_secs config + bootStartedAt boot state plumbing

narrative.Action: Add the primitives FR-1 depends on. (1) config.ts: add reconciliation_max_candidate_age_secs:number to StartupConfig (after reconciliation_grace_secs) and default 240 in DEFAULT_CLOISTER_CONFIG.startup. (2) control-settings.ts: add BOOT_RECONCILIATION_BOOT_STARTED_AT_KEY, add bootStartedAt:string|null to BootReconciliationState, populate it in getBootReconciliationState, and extend stampBootReconciliation(bootId, graceDeadline, bootStartedAt) to persist it. (3) boot-reconciliation.ts: add getBootReconciliationMaxCandidateAgeSeconds() mirroring getBootReconciliationGraceSeconds (falling back to 2x grace when unset/invalid), and stamp bootStartedAt at the START of startBootReconciliation (before listBootReconciliationCandidateIds at ~:116), preserving it across the idempotent existing-bootId branch. All additions are unused-until-consumed so the tree stays green.

Add sync getIssueStageSync + isTerminalIssueStage helper

narrative.Action: Add a synchronous read helper getIssueStageSync(issueId: string): string | null in src/lib/overdeck/agents.ts (co-located with listAllAgentsSync, using getOverdeckDatabaseSync) that SELECTs stage from the issues table for the given id, returning null when absent. Add isTerminalIssueStage(stage: string | null): boolean returning true for verifying_on_main, closed, and cancelled (the terminal Stage literals from src/lib/overdeck/issues.ts). Add a small unit test exercising both. Read-only DB access via the existing sync database accessor keeps this inside the read door.

items.title: getIssueStageSync returns the stored stage string for a known issue and null for an unknown id

Gate isBootReconciliationCandidate to recent + live-workspace + non-terminal work

expected_outputs: boot-reconciliation.test.ts passes including new gate cases
metadata.readinessReason: Touches only boot-reconciliation.ts and its own test file; its inputs (config max-age, bootStartedAt, terminal-stage helper) land in blocking predecessor beads, so it runs in its own wave with no shared-file writer.

narrative.Action: Extend isBootReconciliationCandidate in boot-reconciliation.ts to additionally require, after the existing role/status/paused/troubled/stoppedByUser checks: (a) recency — the newest of lastActivity/stoppedAt/startedAt parses to a time >= (Date.parse(bootStartedAt) - getBootReconciliationMaxCandidateAgeSeconds()*1000), reading bootStartedAt from getBootReconciliationState(); an agent with no usable timestamp is excluded; (b) workspace — agent.workspace is set and existsSync(agent.workspace); (c) non-terminal — !isTerminalIssueStage(getIssueStageSync(agent.issueId)). Update the existing boot-reconciliation.test.ts: extend the hoisted control-settings mock with bootStartedAt, add a config mock for reconciliation_max_candidate_age_secs, mkdir the workspaces used by the existing 'lists only ... resumable candidates' test and give them recent activity + non-terminal stage so it stays green, and ADD gate cases: (1) status=stopped + lastActivity 300h ago + workspace missing is NOT a candidate; (2) stopped seconds before boot + live workspace + open (working) issue IS a candidate; (3) merged/verifying_on_main (terminal) stopped agent is NOT a candidate.

This makes the modal's `set` empty when a fresh boot has only old cleanly-stopped non-candidate agents, while preserving read-only paused/troubled/remote context rows. metadata.readinessReason: Confined to the deacon auto-resume return type and its direct callers/tests; no other bead writes these files, so it runs first in its FR-2 chain with no concurrent writer.

narrative.Action: Change applyBootReconciliationDecision in deacon-auto-resume.ts to return { resumed: string[]; outcomes: Array<{ id: string; issueId: string; outcome: 'resumed' | 'skipped'; reason: string }> } instead of string[]. For each attempted candidate: push {outcome:'resumed'} when handleAgentStoppedEvent returns an id, else {outcome:'skipped', reason:'no-resumable-session'}; for the concurrency-cap break emit {outcome:'skipped', reason:'deferred-concurrency'} and for the load-gate break {outcome:'skipped', reason:'deferred-load'} for each remaining candidate. Update the deacon.ts wrapper applyBootReconciliationDecision() return type accordingly, and the two main.ts call sites (they ignore the value — keep them compiling). Update pan-871-auto-resume.test.ts: existing assertions that read the returned array must read .resumed; ADD a test that applyBootReconciliationDecision over a set of unresumable candidates returns resumed:[] and an outcomes array where every entry is outcome:'skipped' with reason:'no-resumable-session' (no silent no-op).

Render a real resumed/skipped summary in BootReconciliationModal

narrative.Action: In BootReconciliationModal.tsx, extend the decision mutation result type to include outcomes: Array<{id;issueId;outcome;reason}>. Replace the bare onSuccess message ("Boot decision saved. No agents were resumed.", ~:170) with a summary derived from the outcomes: when count>0 show 'Resumed {count} agent(s).'; when count===0 and there were skipped outcomes, summarize by reason (e.g. 'Resumed 0 — {n} skipped (no resumable session).'), grouping counts per reason rather than printing the opaque no-op. Keep the message concise and operator-readable. Defensively tolerate a missing outcomes field (older server) by falling back to the count-based message.

Add pan admin db gc-agents to reap terminal/orphaned agent rows

narrative.Action: Add db.command('gc-agents') in src/cli/commands/db.ts (mounted as `pan admin db gc-agents`) with a --dry-run option. Enumerate rows via listAllAgentsSync(), select role==='work' rows whose issue stage isTerminalIssueStage(getIssueStageSync(issueId)) as reapable (this covers the 44 dead PAN-1791 swarm-slot rows whose issue is terminal). With --dry-run, print the ids/count that WOULD be reaped and make no changes. Without --dry-run, remove each via removeAgentSync(id) (write door: deletes the row AND ~/.overdeck/agents/<id>/) and print a summary. Add a unit test asserting: terminal work rows are reaped, a running/non-terminal-issue work row is preserved, a non-work row is preserved, and --dry-run reaps nothing while still reporting the candidates.
